nightsiege.bar.title: Siege - Level %s - %ss left
nightsiege.book.page1:
Your base will be attacked.

Not by chance, but in waves. Harder every time.
nightsiege.book.page1.title: Night Siege
nightsiege.book.page10:
Chests and bedrock always survive.

Your storage is never at risk.
nightsiege.book.page10.title: Safe
nightsiege.book.page11:
A red bar means danger.

The attackers glow red and are tougher.
nightsiege.book.page11.title: Blood Moon
nightsiege.book.page12:
Sometimes a golden champion leads them.

Cut it down and the wave falters.
nightsiege.book.page12.title: Champion
nightsiege.book.page13:
Every attacker killed earns points.

Champions count tenfold.
nightsiege.book.page13.title: Experience
nightsiege.book.page14:
Right click the core to open everything.

Four branches. Bonuses apply only at night.
nightsiege.book.page14.title: Skill Tree
nightsiege.book.page2:
The siege core is the heart of your base.

Once it stands, the clock runs.
nightsiege.book.page2.title: The Core
nightsiege.book.page3:
The first player is given one.

A new one costs a nether star.
nightsiege.book.page3.title: Replacement
nightsiege.book.page4:
It only runs while three players are within 300 blocks.

Otherwise it stands still.
nightsiege.book.page4.title: The Clock
nightsiege.book.page5:
A horn sounds at sunset.

You then have a few minutes.
nightsiege.book.page5.title: The Warning
nightsiege.book.page6:
A bar appears above with level and time left.

Hold out until it empties.
nightsiege.book.page6.title: The Night
nightsiege.book.page7:
If the time runs out, you have won.

The next night will be harder.
nightsiege.book.page7.title: Victory
nightsiege.book.page8:
If every defender falls, a blast tears your base open.

Level and skills start over.
nightsiege.book.page8.title: Defeat
nightsiege.book.page9:
Only armed attackers dig.

A pickaxe opens stone, an axe opens wood.
nightsiege.book.page9.title: Tools
nightsiege.book.title: Handbook of the Siege

nightsiege.skill.archer_focus.desc: More damage for arrows from a bow.
nightsiege.skill.arrow_storm.desc:
Ult: for a few seconds
every shot fans out into three.
Ult key (default R).
nightsiege.skill.arrow_turret.desc:
Shoots the nearest monster.
Reload with arrows (right click).
Tiers: range, rate, damage.
nightsiege.skill.blast_mine.desc:
Explodes once on contact.
Breaks no blocks, spares players.
nightsiege.skill.blood_drinker.desc:
Part of your melee damage
heals you.
nightsiege.skill.bloodlust.desc:
The less health you have,
the harder you hit.
nightsiege.skill.bolt_volley.desc:
Ult: fires a fan of
7 to 11 bolts.
Ult key (default R).
nightsiege.skill.bombardment.desc:
Ult: blasts land on the nearest
monsters. No block damage.
Ult key (default R).
nightsiege.skill.champion_bane.desc:
Much more damage against
the champion of a night.
nightsiege.skill.double_shot.desc:
Every shot looses
a second arrow.
nightsiege.skill.execute.desc:
Ult: kills the wounded monster
you are looking at.
Ult key (default R).
nightsiege.skill.field_dressing.desc:
Heals every player near you
every 3 seconds.
nightsiege.skill.flame_trap.desc:
Sets every monster around alight.
Starts no fires.
Tiers: longer, wider, more often.
nightsiege.skill.ground_slam.desc:
Ult: throws everything around you
into the air and stuns it.
Ult key (default R).
nightsiege.skill.guardian_angel.desc:
Once a night it saves
a falling teammate.
nightsiege.skill.heavy_blow.desc:
Axe hits deal more damage
and slow.
nightsiege.skill.heavy_bolts.desc:
More damage for bolts
from a crossbow.
nightsiege.skill.heavy_draw.desc:
Much more arrow damage,
short pause after each shot.
nightsiege.skill.holy_light.desc:
Ult: light burns the undead
and heals teammates.
Ult key (default R).
nightsiege.skill.hunt.desc:
Ult: marks every monster
far around you.
Ult key (default R).
nightsiege.skill.impale.desc:
Spear hits also strike
the monster behind.
nightsiege.skill.lance_thrust.desc:
Ult: runs through everything
in a line of 8 blocks.
Ult key (default R).
nightsiege.skill.mass_heal.desc:
Ult: strongly heals every
player within 12 blocks.
Ult key (default R).
nightsiege.skill.overcharge.desc:
Ult: your turrets fire three
times as fast for a while.
Ult key (default R).
nightsiege.skill.poison_trap.desc:
Poison cloud: poisons and weakens.
The undead wither instead.
Tiers: stronger, wider, more often.
nightsiege.skill.power_shot.desc:
Ult: your next shot deals
3 to 4.5 times the damage.
Ult key (default R).
nightsiege.skill.riposte.desc:
Hits caught on your shield
strike back.
nightsiege.skill.shield_charge.desc:
Ult: rams everything in front back.
Ult key (default R).
nightsiege.skill.shrapnel.desc:
Crossbow hits also hurt
monsters next to the target.
nightsiege.skill.snare_trap.desc:
When a monster steps on it, every
monster around is held in place.
Tiers: wider, longer, faster recharge.
nightsiege.skill.spike_trap.desc:
Floor plate: hurts and slows
monsters walking over it.
Tiers: more damage, lasts longer.
nightsiege.skill.sunder.desc:
Axe hits make monsters take
more damage for a while.
nightsiege.skill.swift_draw.desc:
Short bow draws hit
with almost full force.
nightsiege.skill.taunt.desc:
Ult: every monster around turns
on you, and you harden.
Ult key (default R).
nightsiege.skill.tesla_coil.desc:
Lightning jumps monster to monster.
Needs no ammunition.
Tiers: more jumps, more range.
nightsiege.skill.thunderstorm.desc:
Ult: chain lightning from your
hand across many monsters.
Ult key (default R).
nightsiege.skill.toxic_cloud.desc:
Ult: poisons every monster
around you.
Ult key (default R).
nightsiege.skill.tracker.desc:
Monsters you hit glow
and take more damage.
nightsiege.skill.whirlwind.desc:
Ult: hits everything around you
and throws it back.
Ult key (default R).
